learning_objective: 到达或离开时,孩子能主动完成问候或告别(说“你好”/“再见,明天见”),3 次中≥2 次达成。
intro_zh: 见到人的时候,我可以先看看他、笑一笑,说“你好”;要离开的时候,我挥挥手说“再见,明天见”。这样大家都会觉得很友好、很开心。
intro_en: When I see someone, I can look, smile, and say hello. When I leave, I wave and say goodbye, see you tomorrow. This makes everyone feel friendly and happy.

steps.text_zh: 见到人,我先看看他,笑一笑。
steps.text_en: When I see someone, I look at them and smile.
steps.narration_zh: 见到老师或朋友,我先看看他,对他笑一笑。
steps.narration_en: When I see a teacher or a friend, I look at them and give a smile.

steps.text_en: I wave my hand and say hello.
steps.narration_zh: 我挥挥手,用温和的声音说“你好”。
steps.narration_en: I wave my hand and say hello in a friendly voice.

steps.text_zh: 要走了,我说“再见,明天见”。
steps.text_en: When I leave, I say goodbye, see you tomorrow.
steps.narration_zh: 要走的时候,我挥挥手,说“再见,明天见”。
steps.narration_en: When I leave, I wave and say goodbye, see you tomorrow.

steps.text_zh: 打完招呼,朋友也对我笑,我们都很开心。
steps.text_en: After we greet, my friend smiles back and we feel happy.
steps.narration_zh: 打完招呼,朋友也对我笑一笑,我们都觉得很开心、很友好。
steps.narration_en: After we greet each other, my friend smiles back and we both feel happy.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 你的好朋友刚走进来。轮到你,你可以怎么跟他打招呼?
practice_trials.prompt_en: Your friend just came in. Your turn — how can you greet them?

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 玩的时间到了,你要回家了。轮到你,你可以怎么说再见?
practice_trials.prompt_en: Playtime is over and you are going home. Your turn — how can you say goodbye?
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你好好地说了再见,做得好。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You said a nice goodbye. Well done.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 老师看着你,向你问早上好。轮到你,你可以怎么回应老师?
practice_trials.prompt_en: Your teacher looks at you and greets you good morning. Your turn — how can you answer?
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你回应了老师,很有礼貌。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You answered your teacher. Very polite.

social_choice.scenario_zh: 早上你走进教室,看到老师和小朋友……你可以怎么做?
social_choice.scenario_en: In the morning you walk into the room and see your teacher and friends... what can you do?

options.outcome_zh: 你笑着打招呼,大家也笑着回应你,一天有个开心的开始。
options.outcome_en: You greet with a smile, everyone smiles back, and the day starts happily.

options.outcome_zh: 你挥挥手,朋友也向你挥手,你们很快就一起玩了。
options.outcome_en: You wave, your friend waves back, and soon you play together.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 看看他 → 笑一笑 → 说“你好”。
你好 / 早上好 / 再见,明天见。
visual_cards.caption_en: Hello / Good morning / Goodbye, see you tomorrow.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 打招呼让大家觉得友好、开心。
visual_cards.caption_en: Greeting makes everyone feel friendly and happy.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 到了说“你好” → 走了说“再见”。
visual_cards.caption_en: Arrive: say hello. Leave: say goodbye.

review_zh: 我学会了打招呼和再见:见到人先看看他、笑一笑,说“你好”;要走了挥挥手说“再见,明天见”。这样大家都觉得友好,我也交到更多朋友。
review_en: I learned to say hello and goodbye: I look, smile, and say hello when I see someone, and I wave and say goodbye when I leave. Everyone feels friendly and I make more friends.
review_flags: 草稿:循证内容,正式使用前需专业人员按孩子的语言水平与真实校园/家庭情境调整。
